architecture.design: two independent failure-typed heads with one shared TRAIN-only normalizer

claim_boundary: This is the first actual learned gate-weight experiment, but it is B2-core development, not final frozen B2.
Features 4 and 8 remain deferred and Feature 7 remains open; they are not manufactured here.
The two failure heads are not yet combined into a final physical admission score.
Training-set discrimination is descriptive only and is not held-out evidence.
No DEV and no TEST data are read.
